quarterly_data.quarter: FormFactor press release: FormFactor and Teradyne Announce Strategic Collaboration to (10-12-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FormFactor and Teradyne entered into a broad technology collaboration aimed at accelerating the development, validation and high-volume production deployment of next-generation semiconductor devices, combining FormFactor's probe, interface, test engineering and device characterization expertise with Teradyne's automated test platforms; the companies will partner on test architectures, test infrastructure and production readiness for applications including high-performance compute (HPC), advanced packaging, high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and silicon photonics. CEO Mike Slessor: 'By combining FormFactor's deep expertise in device characterization, probing, interfaces, and production test solutions with Teradyne's test platforms, we can help customers accelerate innovation and move more efficiently from technology development to high-volume manufacturing.' The companies say they believe the collaboration will expand opportunities for joint customer engagement.
